title: Nonempty connected one-dimensional nodal geometric fibres
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a locally finitely presented morphism [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. It has nonempty connected one-dimensional nodal geometric fibres if, for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ and geometric point $g:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$, the scheme $X_g=X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre], [def-pc-fibre-product] is nonempty connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] and has topological Krull dimension $1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and each point outside the smooth locus of $X_g\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] has completed local ring isomorphic as a ring to $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$. Completion is at the maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and the two-variable power series ring is [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Geometric tests are in the scheme universe, with the standard invariance under algebraically closed extension.
